source: JLCPCB and LCSC part records, read 2026-11-16: LCSC https://wmsc.lcsc.com/ftps/wm/product/detail?productCode=C14075 (model ATTINY13A-SSU, brand MICROCHIP, package SOIC-8, stock 1071); JLCPCB part page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C14075 (ATTINY13A-SSU, SOIC-8, Extended, no stock figure shown); datasheet: Microchip ATtiny13A Data Sheet DS40002307A (2021), https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/ATtiny13A-Data-Sheet-DS40002307A.pdf, SHA-256 7c363e5deb94b5527a3ebfe9ac98338ce38e7d4499fe481100b7ede44bf37445; Order Information (section 22) gives ATtiny13A-SSU in package 8S1, 8-lead 3.90 mm (.150 in) wide SOIC, 1.8 V to 5.5 V, -40 C to 85 C; the LCSC record links the 20-page summary 8126FS (05/12), whose Figure 1-1 gives the same SOIC pinout
notes: Microchip. The part std::parts::mcu::Attiny13a states its numbers with their tables. LCSC lists the 208 mil ATTINY13A-SU (C9805) too: it is the 8S2 package, not a row, because the part has no pin table for it.
